note: Both sets share the same core claims and the same misbinding: TRL 5 and traceability to WFIRST CGI are attributed to the VVC, but the text assigns both to the HLC ("the HLC is also considered as a backup due to its high technology readiness (TRL 5) and traceability to the WFIRST CGI"). Set A adds four further supported claims (focal plane masks at the focal point, mask wheel at the focal point, parabolic mirror converging the beam, collimated light from M3 as input), while Set B replaces them with one compound optical-train sequence claim whose quote is stitched with ellipses. Set A therefore carries more correct, well-quoted engineering content with no additional errors.
remarks: Both sets misbind TRL 5 and WFIRST CGI traceability to the VVC instead of the HLC (2 wrong claims each). Set B's optical-train sequence claim is supported in substance but its quote is a stitched excerpt with ellipses rather than a contiguous quote. Minor: 'layout simplicity | high' adds a qualifier ('high') not present in the text ('layout simplicity'); treated as acceptable paraphrase rather than an error. Both sets omit the charge-6 immunity to low-order aberrations (tip-tilt, defocus, astigmatism, coma, spherical) and the Table 5.5-6 aberration-sensitivity data. The table caption in the text layer is garbled ("2e 11" = 2×10⁻¹¹, "2 5 3 5 λ/D" = 2.5–3.5 λ/D), and the last sentence is cut off at "a second parabolic".
